Publicity and deification of the Goddesses have led to an increase in Nikke applicants. The Goddesses are nothing more than propaganda created by the Central Government. When I brought that up to the director, he threw me out into the field and told me to go see it for myself.
What a toxic company. I'm quitting as soon as I wrap up this project.
